integrity: Proof is an explicit four-matrix Gram identity. Exact rational enumeration is supplementary, not a replacement for proof; originality is a bounded comparison to the literature and available records, not an exhaustive priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the exactly defined two-coordinate bilinear saddle, unbiased coordinate-selection oracle, balanced iid two-stage coupling, and fixed common stepsize. No assertion of general-dimensional or pathwise convergence.
title: A sharp complementary-sampling threshold for two-coordinate stochastic extragradient
